data_description.away_minutes: A bin is awaiting collection once its normal advertisement has not been heard for this long.
data_description.return_confirm_seconds: A bin is back to filling once its normal advertisement has been heard continuously for this long.

user.title: Add a bin
user.description: The Bluetooth proxies currently hear {count} iBeacon(s) that are not configured yet. Leave the bin still so its normal (idle) advertisement is the one listed, or type the MAC address.

data_description.address: MAC address of the bin's beacon.

data_description.idle_uuid: The UUID the beacon advertises while it is still.
data_description.motion_uuid: The UUID it advertises when it moves. `auto` treats any other iBeacon UUID from this MAC as motion.
data_description.calendar_entity: Optional. Used for the next collection date and the bins-to-take-out summary.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events whose title contains this text (case-insensitive) count, e.g. `rubbish` or `recycling`. Empty matches every event.

data_description.motion_uuid: `auto` treats any other iBeacon UUID from this MAC as motion.
data_description.calendar_keyword: Only events whose title contains this text (case-insensitive) count.

error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.same_uuid: The motion UUID must differ from the idle UUID.
